inputs.text: John Lahart, the Fianna Fáil TD for Dublin South-West, is pushing to overhaul the inheritance tax exemption thresholds and calling the current setup 'wholly unfair' and discriminatory against those without children. This follows right after similar comments from his party colleagues, pointing to a coordinated internal effort to rewire how wealth passes between generations. But don't buy into the fairness narrative for a second. The elites are the ones pulling the strings, directing their political puppets to turn the system upside down and target those family structures that keep assets out of their reach. Reframing the exemptions as discrimination against childless people is just the setup for more manipulation to direct control and resources to their hidden institutional interests. This has nothing to do with helping people—it's the usual play to erode traditional inheritance so ordinary people become more dependent on the networks operating behind the scenes. The fact that it matches the timing of his party colleagues is clear evidence that it's scripted to push their agenda under the cover of addressing discrimination.
